notes.common: conftest imports CLI/Git helpers; support fixtures, migrations and the synthetic integrated_demo.py fixture builder are shared. Unknown/shared changes widen to full.
notes.schema: schema_contract reads DDL/current-schema/contract; invariant test reads inventory/CSV and referenced test AST; design/audit imports are transitive P2 dependencies. Target query tests read complete DDL and verify the reader DDL/schema pins, so they belong to the native schema group.
notes.p2: Conversion imports schema_contract/schema_audit and hashes every conversion module (including admission, phase, identity, identity_phase, git_domain, pr_domain, integrated_parent and integrated_phase); it reads source migrations plus DDL/contracts. P2/P3A/P3B protocols and integrated Git/PR recipes, immutable-parent admission and guarded integrated-flow tests run in native and minimum-p2 lanes. Operational fixtures call the actual v2 Store/index path; integrated flows import target queries and compare stored Git/PR bytes, IDs, order, observations, resume and process interruption. tests/support/operational_source.py, p3b_fixture.py, integrated_fixture.py and subprocess conversion_worker.py/p3b_worker.py/integrated_worker.py remain shared inputs. p3b_fixture exports authentic reviewed Git revision e40430e3f38d3339d67017a04262445f9415a8ec before guarded execution: scripts/conversion/, offline_convert.py, schema_contract.py, schema_audit.py, docs/schema-hardening/ and src/repo_catalog/resources/migrations/. Integrated-parent tests additionally export reviewed P3B revision 94b838d685a075ec4bc5117ef4a09448f9a71945. Runtime reads include target-schema.sql, conversion-contract.json, current-schema.json and migration SQL; corresponding current-tree executable inputs are already covered by schema/common patterns. Minimum predecessor CLI bootstrap separately loads current scripts/sqlite_minimum.py via runpy before guarded old CLI execution. Immutable Git revisions are fixture code inputs and require full checkout history; exported prose is not read by the converter. No legacy HTTP/Git E2E dependency.
notes.demo: demo imports test_cache.expire, test_github_sync.configure and tests.support CLI/Git/HTTP fixtures. integrated_demo.py imports tests.support.integrated_fixture and its operational/P3B fixture dependencies; it is a conservative common input.
notes.reports: These explicit prose/reports are not application/schema fixture inputs. ci-performance-results JSON receives stdlib structure checks. baseline JSON is profiler input and is not prose.
notes.packaging: CLI/resources/build metadata/locked wheels and packaging helpers determine assertions. Report bytes may appear in sdist but are not consumed by installed CLI or packaging assertions. Generated schema views are not prose.
